messages.author: e04bb64c7c0b4424
messages.subject: R Version Instance and Shiny
parts:
I am sorry if this is a stupid question however I am in quite a pickle. I created an application for my company and it was developed on 3.2.0 R. When we ported it to the server, though, it does no work. This is because the server is running on 3.0.0 R. I asked my colleagues if we could upgrade because there are specific libraries that will not work with the older version and I was told that we could not do so because the testing would be to extensive. 

At this point, I really only have 2 options. I can either make the application run on a specific R instance that does not affect the entire server or I can rewrite my code almost completely and lose weeks of works. 

So my question is- is there a way with shiny's runApp feature to specify the R code directory when the application is run? I have downloaded the needed R 3.2.0 files in the directory with the application. I am hoping that there might be a way to have the application just look at that directory when it is run. This way, the company doesn't have to specifically upgrade the entire server, but my application can run properly. 

If you have any suggestions please let me know. It is much appreciated.
